title: How to contact Instagram for support
description: Learn how to contact Instagram support for help with your Instagram account. http://www.christiankonline.com/contact-instagram/  Here are 5 ways to contact Instagram when you need help.   This video tutorial will show you five ways to reach Instagram support.  1. Instagram Help Center - FAQ's http://help.instagram.com/  2. Instagram Help Center - Username issues http://help.instagram.com/contact/111608122342794  3. Facebook - Report an Instagram profile https://www.facebook.com/help/contact/?id=160831917393262  4. Twitter - @Instagram http://www.twitter.com/instagram  5. Instagram on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/InstagramEnglish/app_174927749225665  Should you have additional questions on how to contact Instagram support, don't hesitate to contact me.  Subscribe to my YouTube channel: http://www.youtube.com/subscription_center?add_user=CKARASIEWICZ  Web: http://www.christiankonline.com Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/askck Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/ckroks Google+: http://bitly.com/googck LinkedIn: http://www.linkedin.com/in/christiankarasiewicz

asr.full_text: If you need help with using Instagram, we've compiled a list of our favorite ways to contact Instagram and listed them in the description of this video. Here are some of the highlights from that list. Number one, the Instagram help center. Here you'll find a lot of FAQs. Number two, if you can't log in, you want to fill out the username form within the help center. Numbers three and four, if you need to report a profile, you do that on Facebook and Twitter is great for getting quick answers. Lastly, head to the Instagram Facebook page and there's a complete collection of help forms.
